subject: Hospitality
title: AI Concierges and Chatbots
description: One-minute skill: AI Concierges and Chatbots.

hook.text: Hotel chatbots now answer guest questions 24/7—from restaurant hours to extra towel requests—in seconds.

buildup.text: AI concierges like Marriott's ChatBotlr and Hilton's Connie use natural language to handle routine requests.

discovery.text: These systems resolve 70–80% of common queries without human help, freeing staff for complex needs.

twist.text: Guests rate AI interactions positively for speed but poorly for empathy. Emotional moments still need humans.

climax.text: The best hotels blend AI efficiency with human warmth—bots for logistics, people for connection.

punchline.text: Bots handle the routine. Humans handle the moment. That's the split.

quiz.question: What percentage of common guest queries can AI concierges resolve?
